properties.name: bootui.api-path
properties.description: Internal API base path. Defaults to {@code bootui.path + "/api"}. Override only when the API must be served at a different sub-path from the UI (rare).

properties.name: bootui.enabled
properties.description: Enable BootUI. AUTO activates only in dev/local contexts.

properties.name: management.endpoint.health.probes.enabled
properties.source: Config resource 'class path resource [application.properties]' via location 'optional:classpath:/'
properties.description: Whether to enable liveness and readiness probes.

properties.name: management.endpoints.web.exposure.include
properties.description: Endpoint IDs that should be included or '*' for all.

properties.name: management.tracing.sampling.probability
properties.source: Config resource 'class path resource [application.properties]' via location 'optional:classpath:/'
properties.description: Probability in the range from 0.0 to 1.0 that a trace will be sampled.

properties.name: spring.modulith.events.jdbc.schema-initialization.enabled
properties.source: Config resource 'class path resource [application-full.properties]' via location 'optional:classpath:/'

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.activity.feed-source
propertySuggestions.description: Where the activity stream comes from: {@code journal}, rendering the runtime journal's retained events with every child nested by request or execution id. {@code buffers}, 1.x's feed, was removed in 2.0.0 and fails the start; with the journal disabled, the panel buffers serve the feed on their own. A request may override it with {@code ?source=}.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.activity.max-entries
propertySuggestions.description: Maximum number of normalized entries returned in a single activity-stream page after merging and sorting all sources.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.activity.persistence.dedicated-driver-class-name
propertySuggestions.description: Optional explicit JDBC driver class to load for {@code data-source-mode=DEDICATED}; blank lets the driver auto-register itself from the classpath (the usual case for a modern JDBC 4+ driver).

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.activity.persistence.enabled
propertySuggestions.description: Whether captured Live Activity entries are also durably persisted, in addition to today's in-memory-only default. Disabled by default: no background thread, connection or bean beyond what already exists is created while this is {@code false}.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.allowed-hosts
propertySuggestions.description: Additional Host header values accepted by the loopback safety filter, beyond the built-in loopback names (localhost, 127.0.0.1, ::1). Used to defend against DNS-rebinding attacks while still allowing custom local hostnames.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.github.allowed-api-hosts
propertySuggestions.description: Additional allowed GitHub API hosts. GitHub.com is allowed by default.

propertySuggestions.name: management.endpoints.access.max-permitted
propertySuggestions.description: Maximum level of endpoint access that is permitted. Caps an endpoint's individual access level (management.endpoint.<id>.access) and the default access (management.endpoints.access.default).'
